decisions.reason: The source defines a row-insertion workflow for the Board Meeting structured agenda; it does not change natural paragraph, hard-return, or pasted-content line-break behavior.
The Board Meeting row-insertion workflow does not change required theme colors or the color availability policy.
The source does not address bullet appearance, sizing, alignment, spacing, or level variants.
The source establishes how to extend a Board Meeting agenda by inserting and copying a row; it does not alter multiline entry behavior in the designated Indstilling or Board Seminar fields.
Copying fields into an inserted row does not change whether placeholder text clears when an interactive field is activated.
The source concerns Board Meeting row extension and does not change fixed-margin or graphic-clipping behavior in Vejledning.
The instruction to copy fields within a newly inserted agenda row is not a decision about copying content from legacy templates into new templates.
Although the workflow involves inserting a row, the source does not change the requirement that pasted tables and columns remain within page bounds.
The Board Meeting row workflow does not address Tab-controlled list levels, nested hierarchy, or list alignment.
The source does not add, remove, or revise any required Word style or style-system coverage.
The row-extension workflow does not change the task-local assessment steps, coverage, time budget, or required due-diligence outputs.
The instruction to insert and copy a row does not change the required internal spacing between text and the line on the right.
